description:
Change when an API key stops working: set an end date on a key that has none, move it earlier or later, or pass expires_at null so the key never expires. The key keeps its id, secret, scopes and sub-account; only the date changes, and nothing extends it later. Answers the key as list_api_keys shows it.

Refused before any 2FA code is asked for: a key that is not one of the account's live keys (not_found); a key whose expires_at has passed (api_key_expired — it cannot be revived, create a new key instead); a key an MCP sign-in renews itself (api_key_managed_by_sign_in — list_api_keys shows managed_by_sign_in: true; the user disconnects the AI client to end it). Check list_api_keys first so you do not start 2FA for a refused change.

Agent usage: This operation requires 2FA bound to this key AND this exact value, shortening included: a code confirmed for one date does not set another date or "never". (1) Call set_api_key_expiry with the value the user chose; its 2fa_required refusal lists the exact targets — ["<this key id>", "act:expires_at:<the instant as UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds, e.g. 2027-02-09T14:59:59.999Z>"], or "act:expires_at:never" for null. (2) Call start_2fa with action_type "api_key_expiry" and exactly those targets; the user is shown the date (or "never") they are approving. (3) Wait for the user to verify the code and poll get_2fa_status until "verified". (4) Call set_api_key_expiry again with the SAME value. One code covers one change.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. An API key alone does NOT open this tool.

expires_at.description: The new end date, ISO 8601 with offset, at least 5 minutes ahead — or null for a key that never expires. Ask the user rather than choosing.

name: set_api_key_expiry

outputSchema.description: The key with its new expiry, as the owner's key list shows it. Never carries the key value.

data.description: A live API key as the owner's key list shows it. Never carries the key value.
